title: Construction, crystal structures, and biological activities of two Ln3III complexes

material_class.structural_family: folded Ln3 core bridged by μ2-O atoms

synthesis.procedure: Complexes 1 and 2 were prepared similarly. Ln(dbm)3·2H2O (0.025 mmol) and H2L (0.025 mmol, 0.008 g) were dissolved in a mixed solvent of 10 mL methanol and 5 mL dichloromethane, stirred at room temperature, then sealed in a glass vial and heated in an oven. After the reaction, the vial was removed and cooled naturally to room temperature, giving yellow block crystals suitable for single-crystal diffraction. Yield of 1: 54% based on Pr(dbm)3·2H2O.
synthesis.temperature: room-temperature stirring followed by oven heating (exact oven temperature not recovered from Markdown)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal reaction in a sealed glass vial
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: natural cooling to room temperature; yellow block crystals

properties.summary: UV–vis spectra of 1 in methanol show ligand-centered absorptions (intramolecular π→π* near 228 nm and n→π* near 325–375 nm) with red-shift versus H2L and blue-shift versus Pr(dbm)3·2H2O. UV, CV, and GelRed–DNA fluorescence quenching indicate intercalative binding to ctDNA (Ksq = 0.20). No magnetic data reported.

measurements.name: Stern–Volmer quenching constant Ksq vs GelRed–DNA
measurements.conditions: fluorescence quenching of GelRed–DNA; emission at 620 nm; r = c(complex)/c(DNA)

material_class.structural_family: folded Ln3 core bridged by μ2-O atoms (isostructural with 1)

synthesis.procedure: Same procedure as 1, using Ho(dbm)3·2H2O (0.025 mmol) and H2L (0.025 mmol, 0.008 g) in 10 mL methanol and 5 mL dichloromethane, sealed-vial oven heating, then natural cooling to yellow block crystals. Yield of 2: 51% based on Ho(dbm)3·2H2O.

synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal reaction in a sealed glass vial
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: natural cooling to room temperature; yellow block crystals

properties.summary: Isostructural complex 2 shows the same ligand-centered UV–vis features in methanol as 1. UV, CV, and GelRed–DNA fluorescence quenching indicate intercalative binding to ctDNA (Ksq = 0.19). No magnetic data reported.
